title: Breakthrough of the Year 2025 – Moldova at the table of performance!
body_html:
With gratitude and pride, the members of the Republic of Moldova national table tennis squad, together with the ATTP leadership, were honoured at the 2025 Gala of the Sports Press Association of the Republic of Moldova with the “BREAKTHROUGH OF THE YEAR” award.

This Cup confirms the new path that Moldovan table tennis has set out on. It recognises the courage, hard work and ambition of a generation that chose to believe that Moldova, too, can reach places that once seemed impossible.

The next step is the 2026 World Championships in London.

There, our players will take the table alongside the strongest teams in the world — not as spectators but as equal opponents, in a team that is going there to fight for the podium.

We fight on. For the result. For respect. For Moldova!
